roll_calls.question: On Motion to Recommit — Take Care of America’s Veterans Act (H R 9237)
roll_calls.plain_language: H.R. 9237 (Take Care of America’s Veterans Act) addresses veterans’ benefits, health care, counseling, Department of Veterans Affairs personnel, VA infrastructure, and the Veterans Community Care Program. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

Since the beginning of the 119th Congress, our Committee has led the charge to ensure the United States wins the race for AI while simultaneously safeguarding local interests. This competition will decide who is THE superpower of the next generation – it is that important.

post.text: This week, the House will vote on @HouseCommerce’s Ratepayer Protection Act to codify President Trump’s Ratepayer Protection Pledge and prevent Americans from being forced to foot the bill for energy infrastructure upgrades to power data centers. This bill is fundamental to winning the race for AI and protecting local communities and ratepayers.

roll_calls.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in Senate Adt to House Adt to Senate Adt — Housing for the 21st Century Act (H R 6644)
roll_calls.plain_language: The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act establishes and modifies various federal housing programs. This vote, under suspension of the rules, was on accepting the Senate's latest changes to the bill after the chambers traded versions, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea accepts the Senate's version; a Nay opposes it.

post.text:
The idea of home ownership has become out of reach for too many Americans. I recently joined the @KyChamber, Members of the General Assembly, and housing groups from across the Commonwealth to discuss pathways to restore the American Dream of owning a home.

As Chairman of @HouseCommerce, I have helped lead the charge in restoring consumer choice and eliminating burdensome Biden-Harris Administration regulations that increased construction and appliance costs in new homes.

Additionally, earlier this year Congress enacted the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act into law, which will make it easier for homebuyers to streamline housing development, expand local lending, and prevent large investors from purchasing more than 350 single-family homes and price out individual buyers.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.
